messages:
Maya: dropping the near-final draft here: https://docs.redwood.ai/launchs/release-inference-post-v4.md — please scan for CTA placement, benchmark wording, and any legal flags. target publish Thu 4/2 10am PT.

Ben: reading now. quick note: we need the measurement appendix link for any numeric claims and avoid absolutes like 'always' or 'guaranteed'. will mark up doc.

Olivia: will do tone pass after Ben. priority: hero CTA wording (Register vs Learn) and the small form fields for region + demo opt-in.

Samira: bench check: final 95th = 118ms on g5-16 with int8 quant and adaptive KV cache headroom. raw csv at s3://bench/release/95p_2026-03-25.csv. want me to include a tiny table or keep it narrative?

Maya: table would be nice but keep it compact. maybe a 2-row snippet under the benchmarks section. include a one-line measurement note.

Samira: cool. suggested snippet: ```Model | HW | 95th
LlamaX-7B-int8 | g5-16 | 118ms``` and note: measured across 1k requests, median prompt 56 tokens, batching disabled.

Olivia: that reads well. add parenthetical: (internal benchmark; actual results vary by workload).

Ben: legal ok with that phrasing if we link appendix and add the parenthetical. also remove 'best-in-class' phrasing from the opener.

Zach: hero concept previewed to design — they'd like a customer quote for the hero. @Jake from Sentra had that line in beta: "Redwood made inference predictable and cut our cost". Jake, can we publish that exact quote?

Jake: fine to use that wording. small edit: drop "cut" -> "reduced" for clarity. full: "Redwood made inference predictable and reduced our cost." you have my permission.

Rina: Ops / HubSpot: for CTAs please map as follows — Register webinar -> Form: webinar_reg (workflow: webinar-nurture-7d), Download benchmark -> Form: bench_download (tag: bench-lead). Add region dropdown (NA/EU/APAC) and demo checkbox that sets demo_requested = true. I'll need the form field names to wire up webhooks.

Maya: adding mapping in the draft. snippet in doc: ```CTA -> HubSpot form mapping
Register webinar -> webinar_reg (workflow: webinar-nurture)
Download benchmark kit -> bench_download (tag: benchmark)
Form fields: email, company, region, demo_request:checkbox```

Rina: perfect. also request: set registrant scoring rule to +10 for demo_request so SDRs get flagged.

Ben: noted. legal final pass mostly inline, one micro-edit around competitor mention removed.

Olivia: i'll do final copyedit once Ben posts inline suggestions. will hand to design for hero image and the benchmark graphic after that.

launch-bot: ops-handoff meeting created: Mon 2026-03-30 09:00 PT with #marketing-ops and Rina invited.

Maya: timeline recap: legal by Mon EOD, copy edit Tue AM, design Tues afternoon, ops handoff Wed morning. aiming publish Thu 2026-04-02 10:00 PT. thanks all :raised_hands:
